scope: Only current column/default/PK/UNIQUE/CHECK metadata for isolated R07 SQL tests. Foreign keys, RLS, triggers and Auth/PostgREST are not simulated by these definitions.

constraints.name: connection_policy_versions_snapshot_identity
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((policy_snapshot ->> 'schema'::text) = 'CONNECTION_POLICY_V1'::text) AND ((policy_snapshot ->> 'policyKey'::text) = policy_key) AND ((NULLIF((policy_snapshot ->> 'version'::text), ''::text))::integer = version) AND ((policy_snapshot ->> 'beneficiaryRole'::text) = beneficiary_role) AND ((policy_snapshot ->> 'activationReason'::text) = activation_reason) AND ((policy_snapshot ->> 'chargeMode'::text) = charge_mode) AND ((policy_snapshot ->> 'unitBasis'::text) = unit_basis) AND ((NULLIF((policy_snapshot ->> 'platformCostRsd'::text), ''::text))::integer = platform_cost_rsd)))

constraints.name: marketplace_responses_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((proposed_start_at IS NULL) AND (proposed_end_at IS NULL)) OR ((proposed_start_at IS NOT NULL) AND (proposed_end_at IS NOT NULL) AND (proposed_start_at < proposed_end_at))))

columns.name: approx_geog
columns.default:
CASE
    WHEN ((approximate_lat IS NOT NULL) AND (approximate_lng IS NOT NULL)) THEN (st_setsrid(st_makepoint((approximate_lng)::double precision, (approximate_lat)::double precision), 4326))::geography
    ELSE NULL::geography
END

constraints.name: needs_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((ends_at IS NULL) OR (starts_at IS NULL) OR (ends_at > starts_at)))

constraints.name: needs_price_basis_requires_my_price
constraints.definition: CHECK (((price_basis IS NULL) OR ((price_basis = ANY (ARRAY['TOTAL'::text, 'PER_PERSON'::text, 'HOURLY'::text])) AND (mode = 'MY_PRICE'::text))))

constraints.name: needs_urgent_window_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT urgent) OR ((urgent_activated_at IS NOT NULL) AND (urgent_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (urgent_expires_at > urgent_activated_at))))
